verdict.rationale: Luma documents character references, facial-expression transfer and transforming people into new characters. None of the evidence describes creating a custom avatar of a real person, and none describes a consent or verification flow for one. Character-reference generation is an adjacent capability, not the documented consent-gated avatar creation this story asks for.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can create a custom avatar of a real person through a documented consent and verification flow
